description: Images in the Apple Ads asset library with format, orientation, dimensions and eligibility — use it to check whether an uploaded asset has finished processing before referencing it in a creative. Filter by mapsBrandId (Apple’s promotedObjectId), promotedObjectType or assetType, or pass id for one. CROPS AND OTHER VARIANTS NEVER APPEAR IN A LIST: Apple omits them from query results, so a variant has to be fetched by its own id. Querying covers both App Store apps and Apple Maps brands even though only Maps assets can be uploaded. Read-only, free.

assetType.description: asset type; IMAGE is the only one listed

id.description: Fetch one asset — the only way to see a crop or variant.

limit.description: maximum number of assets to return

mapsBrandId.description: Scope to one brand or app (promotedObjectId).

promotedObjectType.description: APPSTORE_APP or BUSINESS_BRAND: which kind of promoted object the assets belong to

name: list_apple_ads_assets
title: List Apple Ads image assets
